description: Read-only checks on a live project, for when an app misbehaves after deploying: url (request the project's own live addresses from The Deployer's side, for when you can't reach them yourself), containers (what runs and its state), app_logs (the app's own recent output, secrets removed; container picks one), resources (load, memory, disk) or web_server (the HTTPS proxy's log). Fixed commands only, nothing changes. Everything but url needs a server (not managed services). Needs Deploy on the project.

container.description: app_logs only: one container name from containers

project.description: The project's id, name or repository (owner/name).

workspace.description: Act in a teammate's workspace: its id from account. Default: your own.

name: diagnose
title: Check a live server
